top_signals.title: How India Turned Cricket Into A Billion Dollar Business
top_signals.summary: India’s obsession with cricket has helped turn the Indian Premier League into one of the world’s most valuable sports leagues, attracting foreign investors like Blackstone. With only 10 teams serving a country of roughly 1.5 billion people, investors see scarcity, rising media consumption and India’s economic growth as powerful drivers of team valuations.  (Source: Bloomberg)
